title: fix(ui): a view a read-only package ships offers no footer calculation menu and no Rename
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVwX4pUdM1qvNLSqRZNSvv3)_

## 维护者速读

- 管理员打开只读包自带的列表视图时，表格底部不再出现「计算」下拉菜单，选项菜单里也不再有「重命名」；自定义包里保存的共享视图和个人视图照旧都有。
- 属于列表页重做专题：替管理员去掉一个点了必被服务器拒绝的入口（之前选完会回滚并弹提示）。
- 出错时最坏情况是该给的菜单没出现，管理员要改共享视图就得走视图设置；读不到包列表时菜单照旧出现，可直接撤回本改动。
- 无。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/data-objectstack` `listViews()`: each row now carries the package the server served it under (the item's `_packageId`), on both arms. The `config`-flattening arm rebuilt the row from `config` and dropped it; the bare-spec arm now also carries an item-level `_packageId` when the spec is nested. The return type is unchanged (a Promise of `any[]`).
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `ObjectView`: an admin on a saved shared view is offered the footer calculation pick (`pickSummary`, from #35702) and the options menu's Rename only when the view's package is not one the server's package list carries as read-only. The verdict is the packages row's `writable` (`isWritablePackage`, ADR-0070 D2), read through `usePackagePosture` / `fetchSessionPackages`, the same session-held read the app bar's Studio entries already make, so no new request on a page the app bar has drawn. A row with no package (personal view, stored view bound to none, the `sys_metadata` sentinel) stays savable; the package id is read with the existing `studioPackageId` guard, now exported from `utils/appRoute.ts` (not re-exported from the package entry).
- Fails open on purpose: while the list is unread, when the read fails, and for a package the list leaves out (kernel packages), the menu stays as it was before and the server's refusal still applies.
- No name-shape rule: every stored view is named `object.key`, the console's own saved shared views included.

Read first (risk order):
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` — the two `!activeViewPackageRefusesSaves` conditions in `listViewActions` (`rename`, `pickSummary`) and the `activeSavedViewRow` read above them.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useStudioDesignGate.ts` — `usePackageRefusesSaves`, the fail-open answer over `usePackagePosture`.
3. `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` — `listViews`' map: `row._packageId` on the flattening arm, the rebuilt bare-spec return.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.readOnlyPackageView-35933.test.tsx` → 6 passed; the first case reads "a view a read-only package ships: no calculation menu, no Rename".

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.readOnlyPackageView-35933.test.tsx` (new, 6 cases, real `ObjectView`, `ListView` stand-in recording its props, `fetchSessionPackages` stubbed): a read-only package's view gets no `onColumnSummaryPick` and no `onRenameView`; a customization-package shared view, a view bound to no package and a personal view get the pick; an unread list and a failed read leave the pick on the shipped view.
- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/listViews.servedPackage-35933.test.ts` (new, 3 cases): a flattened ViewItem row keeps `_packageId` (shipped and custom), a bare spec row keeps it, a row served with none gains none.

Runs at head `bfa65e89` (local, under the shared verify lock). `bfa65e89` is the pre-push spelling of this PR's head `fa4ec1b6`: the only change between them is the commit trailer reworded to the model-free pair, and `git diff bfa65e89 fa4ec1b6` is empty, so every local reading below is a reading of `fa4ec1b6`'s tree:

<details><summary>Targeted suites: 228 files / 2396 tests passed</summary>

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useStudioDesignGate packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/appRoute.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/spec-symbol-parity.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/SidebarItemMenu.designFollowsPackagePosture-12615.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/columnSummaryWrite-35702.test.ts packages/data-objectstack/` → `Test Files  228 passed (228)` · `Tests  2396 passed (2396)` · `VERDICT command-exit 0`. That is every `ObjectView*` suite, the Studio-gate and `appRoute` suites, and the whole `@object-ui/data-objectstack` package. The whole `@object-ui/app-shell` package (2357 test files) is declared to CI's Test UI shards, not run locally: a local full run held the shared lock for 20 minutes without finishing and was stopped.

</details>

<details><summary>Type-check: both packages exit 0</summary>

`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter @object-ui/data-objectstack --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` → both `Done`, `VERDICT command-exit 0` (app-shell's includes `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, which compiles the new test).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations: each gate reverted, its pin goes red, restore proven</summary>

All via `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob moved, restore blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty). The tests import the source relatively, so no `dist/` is in the path.

1. `pickSummary` gate (`: isAdmin && !activeViewPackageRefusesSaves && isSavedViewId(` → `: isAdmin && isSavedViewId(`): "a view a read-only package ships: no calculation menu, no Rename" fails, `expected true to be false`; 5 others pass.
2. Rename gate (`activeView && isAdmin && !activeViewPackageRefusesSaves && savedViews.some(` → without the middle term): the same case fails, `expected [Function] to be undefined`.
3. Adapter carry (the line `if (packageId !== undefined) row._packageId = packageId;` deleted): "a flattened ViewItem row keeps its `_packageId`, shipped or custom" fails; 2 others pass. The bare-spec case passes either way: that arm already kept a spec-level `_packageId`, and the case pins it.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The view settings panel's Save is not gated here (seat ruling, scope A): on a read-only package's view the panel is also how an admin reads the view's configuration, so whether it opens read-only or its entry is hidden is a product choice. Today that save is still refused by the server with the "save it into the customization package" message. Remainder moves to #35974.
- The Manage views dialog's pin, set default and delete on such a view are not touched by this PR; they are in #35974 too.
- A view a kernel package ships keeps the menu (the package list leaves kernel packages out, so their verdict is unknown here); the server refuses that save as before.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gate families: 41 derived, 41 run, 0 NOT MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (merge base `9ed18a50e`, head `bfa65e89`) derived 41 families. All 41 exited 0. Two needed a second run because the first never got the lock (`vitest run scripts/` exit 99; `check:type-check-debt` exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET). Their reruns under the lock: `scripts/` 172 passed / 2 skipped files, 5111 tests; type-check-debt `0 ledger entr(ies) re-measured ... none above its recorded number`. `--ran` reconciliation with exit codes: `41 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Clause-② measurement: no</summary>

The built declaration `ui/packages/data-objectstack/dist/index.d.ts` still declares `listViews(objectName, options?: { previewDrafts?: boolean })` returning a Promise of `any[]`, as on main. This diff adds no exported type or symbol to a published entry. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`. The exported `studioPackageId` and `usePackageRefusesSaves` are not re-exported from its entry (`src/index.ts` names `resolveHostAppSegment, appRouteSegment, filterActiveApps` from `./utils` and no Studio-gate hook).

</details>

Overlap: `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=claude/issue-35933-view-package-gate` → merges cleanly with `origin/main`, #35918 and #35910 (each shares `ObjectView.tsx`); `VERDICT clean exit 0`.

Not browser-verified: NOT MEASURED, reason: no showcase stand was booted for this card. The same refusal path is browser-measured on #35919 (`rt-07`), and the gate is pinned against the real `ObjectView` above.
